map.：算法：扇形面积 A=r²·θ/2（θ 弧度）；等价 A=πr²·(deg/36: Algorithm: sector area A = r²·θ/2 (θ in radians); equivalently A = πr²·(deg/360) where deg is the angle in degrees. θ must be entered in radians, so convert degrees first (θ = deg·π/180). Requires r > 0 and deg ≥ 0.
map.：例：r=10m、θ=90° → 弧度=π/2、A=100×1.5708/2=7: Example: r = 10 m, θ = 90° → radians = π/2, A = 100×1.5708/2 = 78.5398 m² (a quarter of the full circle π·100: π·100·90/360 = 78.5398, consistent). If θ = 60° → A = 52.3599 m² (a sixth of the full circle).

map.扇形面积和弧长什么关系？: What is the relation between sector area and arc length?
map.扇形是圆弧+两条半径围成的区域，面积=½·r·弧长（因弧长 L=rθ，A=½r²: A sector is a circular arc plus two radii, and its area = ½·r·arc length (because arc length L=rθ, A=½r²θ=½r·L). The two are the same relation, so if the arc length is known the area follows directly.
map.圆心角超过 360° 呢？: What if the central angle exceeds 360°?
map.几何上扇形通常 0~360°；若输入 >360° 会得到超过整圆的面积，可能不符: Geometrically a sector spans 0-360°; entering more than 360° returns an area larger than the full circle, which may not match the figure definition, so keep the input within 0-360°.
